env_allowlist.PATH: ambient tool-discovery path; executable identities are verified by digest
env_allowlist.HOME: ambient elan toolchain root; release evidence remains nonrelease
env_allowlist.LANG: ambient for host-side Python/Git/Lake checks; Lean replay is forced to C.UTF-8
env_allowlist.LC_ALL: ambient for host-side Python/Git/Lake checks; Lean replay is forced to C.UTF-8
env_allowlist.TZ: ambient for host-side Python/Git/Lake checks; Lean replay is forced to UTC

network_enforcement: Lean elaboration runs through bubblewrap --unshare-net with fixed locale and timezone. Host-side hash, manifest, Git, and invariant checks use no network.
environment_boundary: Host-side environment is not hermetic and makes this recipe nonrelease evidence. Only the Lean subprocesses run with fixed locale/timezone and network isolation; executable digests are recomputed.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact six-line gate and verdict summary retained in release-receipt.json

coverage_semantics: covered_obligation_ids are the nodes directly checked by Lean or exact node-boundary assertions. reconciled_inventory_ids are structurally inspected only to derive a fail-closed terminal decision and receive no proof-closure credit.
scope_boundary: Current worker-side fail-closed reconciliation and warm-cache kernel replay. It cannot close the o-minimal monotonicity root, accept the provisional dependency, produce release-grade cold/offline or independent evidence, or perform master acceptance.
